source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entries 2060 and 2065 stop deep-importing eslint-plugin-mozilla/lib/configs and remove a redundant local static-test config. The legacy root override spread both the config and its rules so func-names could be changed without discarding inherited rules. The fixed accepted tree has eslint.config.mjs and flat/xpcshell-test and flat/browser-test exports. Harness paths and overlapping rules still determine the applicable result. A historical deletion claiming identical rules is not proof of current resolved settings. This is a configuration migration observation, not a rule for ordinary module imports. Static source inspection only; no ESLint configuration resolution or lint run.
title: Use the Mozilla ESLint package config export for the relevant harness
